meta.name: Mary George
meta.description: In 17th century England, Mary Villiers molds her beautiful son, George, to seduce King James I, intending to gain riches and influence through outrageous schemes.

videos.title: The Second Son
videos.overview: To change her family's fortunes, Mary Villiers convinces her son George to take action.

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: Mary resorts to drastic measures to help her son impress the king. George attempts to stand out from the crowd.

videos.title: Not So Much As Love As by Awe
videos.overview: As Somerset puts George under pressure, Mary must find a way to persevere or risk losing everything.

videos.title: The Wolf & the Lamb
videos.overview: Mary goes head-to-head with Lady Hatton, while George faces a daunting and dangerous trip to Scotland.

videos.title: The Golden City
videos.overview: A crisis is triggered when Sir Walter Raleigh returns, driving a wedge between Mary, George and King James.

videos.title: The Queen Is Dead
videos.overview: George risks everything as he navigates the affairs of the state, while Mary faces her own dire consequences.

videos.title: War
videos.overview: George and Charles embark on a historical trip to Spain. Mary attempts one last throw of the dice to ensure absolute power.
